preconditions.description: Must have riskControl role or equivalent permission to close positions
Contract must hold WBTC tokens (insurance funds) that can be transferred

exploit_hint: Trigger the riskControl position closing function that transfers insurance funds but fails to properly update the user's available funds state. After the transfer, the user's available funds remain non-zero, allowing them to withdraw the same funds again. Call the withdrawal function to extract the duplicate funds.
